requirements.name: Automated refund initiation workflow
requirements.summary: The system must automatically trigger refund processes when a dispute is validated or a delivery fails.

requirements.name: Partial refund calculation engine
requirements.summary: The system must calculate and apply partial refunds based on specific missing or damaged items in an order.

requirements.name: Failed delivery retry scheduling
requirements.summary: The system must automatically reassign failed deliveries to available agents based on proximity and capacity.

requirements.name: Order cancellation rollback mechanism
requirements.summary: The system must reverse inventory locks and financial reservations when an order is cancelled before dispatch.

requirements.name: Dispute evidence collection portal
requirements.summary: The system must allow agents and customers to upload photos and documents to support dispute claims.

requirements.name: Escalation routing for complex disputes
requirements.summary: The system must route unresolved disputes to senior support tiers based on severity and financial impact.

requirements.name: Refund status notification service
requirements.summary: The system must send real-time updates to customers regarding the status of their refund requests.

requirements.name: Chargeback prevention alert system
requirements.summary: The system must flag high-risk transactions to prevent unauthorized chargebacks before settlement occurs.
